entities.summary: Emil Johansson is a Swedish professional ice hockey defenceman who plays for Dresdner Eislöwen of the Deutsche Eishockey Liga (DEL). Johansson was selected by the Boston Bruins in the seventh round of the 2014 NHL Entry Draft.
